section: A Sabbath-Rest for the People of God

heading.en: Make every effort to enter it

body.en: There is still a REST promised to God's people today — not just a physical land, but a deep rest of trusting God completely. The writer warns: let us be careful that none of us fails to reach that rest through unbelief, the way the wilderness generation did. Let us make every effort to enter it! And here's a sobering truth: God's Word is alive and active, sharper than any double-edged sword, penetrating even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow — able to judge the thoughts and intentions of every heart. Nothing in all creation is hidden from God's sight; everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account. This rest isn't laziness — it's the deep confidence of trusting God so completely that striving and worry can finally stop.

verse.en: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest.

title.en: A Song for A Rest Still Waiting

q.en: What is the 'rest' the writer says is still available today?
How is God's Word described in this chapter?

en: Alive and active, judging the heart

q.en: What does the writer urge believers to do regarding this rest?

en: Make every effort to enter it

label.en: Activity sheet: A Rest Still Waiting

body.en:
Big idea: the "rest" theme points beyond Canaan to present trust requiring active pursuit (4:11) — paradoxically, entering true rest takes real effort, the opposite of careless presumption.

Conversation starters: (1) What does "resting" in God look like while still making effort? (2) Why is striving toward rest not a contradiction? (3) How does it feel to know God's Word can see into your thoughts?

Pray for hearts that truly rest in God's trustworthiness.
